Deliverables

I split my time between two rooms. In the projection booth, I calibrate, troubleshoot and maintain the projector and sound systems across all 12 EAP Films & Theatres auditoriums — so the picture stays sharp and the mix stays locked, screening after screening. On the design side, I build the posters, now-showing boards and social campaigns that put Savoy Cinemas on people's radar in the first place.

It's an unusual pairing, but it works: understanding exactly how a film reaches the screen makes me better at designing the art that sells it. When the lights go down, both jobs are already done.
